newsitem.title: UK: DAS Air starts UK-Bahrain B707 cargo service.
newsitem.headline: DAS Air starts UK-Bahrain B707 cargo service.

text.p: DAS Air Cargo said it has this week started a weekly London Gatwick-Bahrain Boeing 707 freighter service, which continues onward to points in West Africa.

Gil Harding, managing director of Ugandan carrier DAS Air's management company, UK-based ANA Aviation Services, told Reuters that the 707F would be replaced by a DC-10 freighter when the carrier takes delivery of the second of these aircraft in October.

"If there is sufficient demand for a second weekly frequency then we will respond to it. But it is early days and there are no plans for such expansion at present," he said. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
